purpose: Preserve and adjudicate first-run QA failures without rewriting their evidence.

corrections.reason: The first assertion coupled the required Q02 completion notice to retention of an earlier draft frame. The approved terminal contract requires service_incomplete plus content_review_incomplete and an atomic complete saved package; it does not require the earlier frame when the current complete package remains valid.
corrections.adjudication: The immutable first result already records service_incomplete, final_content_version 2, content_review_incomplete, successful status recovery and q02_save_allowed. No product defect.

corrections.reason: The synthetic content-review finding quoted text that was not an exact substring of the reviewed clean passage, so the implementation correctly rejected the finding before repair.
corrections.adjudication: After changing only synthetic evidence to exact quotes, n2-method-retest-final.json passed: limit_finalized V4, two repairs, three reviews, forced_wording and contradiction persisted, and internal rounds stayed out of the public stream.

corrections.reason: The initial browser method required prototype class names, inferred focus from body text, assumed a closed dialog remained mounted, and used labels that differed from approved copy.
corrections.adjudication: browser-results-final.json uses visual/interaction outcomes, a stable Home-link focus identity, hidden-or-unmounted dialog behavior, and approved labels Preset title plus Essential/Enhanced generation. All affected checks pass.
